speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore will have to navigate an increasingly complex and unpredictable strategic and security landscape.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The shifts in global power and competition for influence among the major powers, particularly in the Asia Pacific, will impact the global and regional order, bringing both unprecedented risks and opportunities for us as a nation.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The rise of nationalism, protectionism and the polarisation of society in many regional countries have further exacerbated the challenges faced by Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The geopolitical challenges in the Middle East, particularly the threat of the Islamic State, and the disputes in the East and South China Sea, will remain intractable.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Economically, the global outlook is uncertain, although landmark initiatives, such as the ASEAN Economic Community (AEC) and Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP), offer promising prospects.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: ASEAN remains a cornerstone of Singapore's foreign policy and provides the necessary bedrock for a stable, peaceful and prosperous region.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: ASEAN creates a platform for us to engage key major powers at a regional level.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore will continue to work actively to enhance ASEAN integration and centrality in the evolving regional architecture, as well as deepen ASEAN's relations with its external partners.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will host a number of important meetings in Singapore, including the ASEAN Summit, ASEAN Plus Three Summit and the East Asia Summit (EAS), presenting us an opportunity to showcase and advance the interests of Singapore and ASEAN to the world.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will make a concerted effort to promote ASEAN identity and awareness among Singaporeans through the mainstream and social media, as well as through initiatives, such as the Annual Youth Model ASEAN Conference, which aims to educate and engage younger Singaporeans about the workings behind ASEAN.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: As we embark on a year-long series of celebrations and projects to mark Singapore's chairmanship, MFA will partner key stakeholders, including the business community and civil society.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: As a small nation-state, developing strong, sustainable and multifaceted partnerships at all levels is vital for Singapore's long-term security and continued prosperity.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will endeavour to strengthen our relations with our immediate neighbours, Malaysia and Indonesia, which have made steady and substantive progress in recent years.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With upcoming projects like the joint developments in Singapore and Iskandar Malaysia, the High Speed Rail and the Rapid Transit System, there is a strong impetus for closer cooperation between Malaysia and Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: In the case of Indonesia, we seek to expand our mutually-beneficial cooperation, following President Joko Widodo's introductory visit to Singapore in July 2015, where both countries signed agreements to strengthen collaboration in various sectors, including public policy, youth and sports and economic development.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Boosting economic and people-to-people ties with other ASEAN member states is another priority.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Beyond Southeast Asia, Singapore will continue to intensify our engagement with the major powers.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will identify new avenues to maintain and strengthen our close political, economic and strategic ties with the US, China and other regional stakeholders.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The recently 	Page: 34 enhanced Defence Cooperation Agreement with the US provides a broader framework to expand our bilateral cooperation with the US.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With other key partners like Australia, India, Japan, Republic of Korea and the European Union, we will seek to strengthen bilateral cooperation in economic as well as security areas, such as counter-terrorism and cybersecurity.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: India and Singapore, for instance, have elevated relations to a Strategic Partnership and both sides will expand cooperation in areas, such as skills development and urban solutions.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With Australia, the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership will enhance cooperation across economic, defence, security and people-to-people fields.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: To further expand Singapore's international space, we will continue to play a constructive role in various multilateral fora.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Through the UN, WTO and Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC), we will actively contribute to the global agenda, including climate change, sustainable development, trade liberalisation and upholding the rules-based multilateral trading system.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to demonstrate Singapore's usefulness to the G20 process through our convenorship of the Global Governance Group (3G).

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore will reinforce its role as a responsible member of the international community by extending technical assistance to, and sharing our developmental experience with, other countries through the Singapore Cooperation Programme (SCP).

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Regional initiatives, such as the AEC, TPP and Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) will create new trade and investment opportunities for Singapore companies in a broader economic hinterland.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The AEC will integrate ASEAN into a single regional market, thereby facilitating a freer flow of goods, services, investment and capital among member states.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The negotiations on the RCEP are ongoing and, when concluded, will transform ASEAN and its FTA partners into an integrated market.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Together, the AEC, TPP and RCEP are key pathways to the eventual realisation of a Free Trade Area in the Asia Pacific.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Through active diplomacy by our overseas missions, non-resident Ambassadors and Honorary Consuls-General and in collaboration with our economic agencies, MFA will facilitate access to overseas markets for Singapore companies in sectors where they have comparative strengths, such as infocomm technology (ICT) and urban planning.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will promote Singapore as a major global and regional business hub for foreign companies seeking to expand to the region while, at the same time, promote Singapore's vibrancy through greater cultural and people-to-people linkages and public diplomacy.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Page: 35 The engagement of Singaporeans living and working overseas remains a priority for MFA.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Through a variety of socio-cultural community events, our aim is to foster a sense of belonging and national identity amongst a growing number of overseas Singaporeans all over the world.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to work closely with the Overseas Singaporean Unit (OSU), as well as Singapore associations, to achieve this goal.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With more Singaporeans travelling and residing overseas, MFA will expand our consular outreach by leveraging on modern technology and expanding our diplomatic network, while partnering key stakeholders, including the media as well as public and private sector organisations.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With increasing occurrences of natural disasters and other emergencies, MFA will work closely with other Government agencies and foreign governments to render consular assistance and ensure the safety of our Singaporeans abroad.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singapore must aspire to be an extraordinary nation by strengthening our bilateral, regional and international relations and our international standing.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We must be cognisant of our vulnerabilities, yet constantly search for fresh opportunities to enhance our relevance and expand our political, economic and diplomatic space.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: MFA will work closely with other Government agencies, private sector organisations, as well as our fellow citizens, to safeguard and advance Singapore's interests in an interconnected world.
